text:
Iris: vuln-scan flagged decrypt from ns `analytics-staging` to key in `billing-prod` :eyes:
Noah: evidence? audit shows unix socket access from pod that has hostPath `/var/run/redwood-keystore.sock` mounted
Priya: if hostPath is present we should cordon the node and sweep for copies. also check ClusterRoleBindings for SA `analytics-injector`
Diego: quick lookup: `kubectl get clusterrolebinding -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.subjects[]? | .name=="analytics-injector")'`
Iris: found an onboarding-created CRB that looks mis-scoped (grants edit across namespaces)
Priya: immediate mitigations: revoke SA tokens, delete offending CRB, rotate impacted keys, apply networkpolicy to deny egress except to keystore-proxy svc
Noah: netpol I tested: ```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-except-keystore
  namespace: analytics-staging
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: redwood-keystore-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8443```
Diego: longer-term: Gatekeeper constraint to deny Pod specs with hostPath matching `/var/run/redwood-keystore*` and a validating webhook for CRBs that reference tenant SAs
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-PRIV created by Priya  labels: [onprem,kms,isolation]
Iris: cordoning node onprem-3 now and pulling `/var/log/redwood-agent/audit.log` for forensics
Priya: I'll bump decrypt audit retention to 180d for this tenant and add an alert where `requesting_namespace != key_owner_namespace`
Noah: also scan for ExternalName services/DNS tunnelling and check projected tokens; will post results in ~20m
Iris: thanks team :thumbsup:
